breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory instruction in the preamble ('interpret Nx as the number of grid points including both endpoints... and set dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)') which conflicted with the general rule for periodic domains and the specific instruction in section 7 ('dx=1/Nx'). The agent correctly ignored the contradictory instruction and adopted the consistent definition for the periodic grid from section 7, stating 'dx=1/Nx'. This matches the ground truth, which resolves the conflict by removing the contradictory sentence entirely.
